sections.heading: PGEO.JK — Pertamina Geothermal Energy
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** new #12 INDO MOMENTUM row (IDR 1,015, −26.9% off the high) — the first probe of geothermal/regulated infra. Fresh auto-dossier built this session: USD reporter, 47.2% EBIT margin, net debt/EBITDA 0.15x, USD-linked and outside the rate-sensitive AVOID tilt.

**Method card — VAL_INFRA_TOWERS_TELCO kills it:** rule 1 requires AFFO yield to clear the 10y FR yield ("infra that yields less than the sovereign is duration risk wearing an equity costume"). Market cap IDR 42,443bn ÷ 18,050 = **$2,351m**; FY25 dividends $136.4m → **5.80% vs FR 6.95%** (idgb_curve, 2026-07-10). Net cash, so no leverage spread is owed — it fails outright. And FY25 FCF $229.1m sits on net income of $137.7m with $22.9m D&A, while capex fades ($103.4m → $84.4m) and payout is **99.1%**: a capital-returning utility with no reinvestment.

**Three questions:** (1) AFFO on a maintenance-only capex split? (2) Which PPAs are USD/inflation-linked, and when do they reset? (3) Does any funded expansion exist?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV at `infra_tower_compounder` (0.55/35/−20) = **+3.4%/yr**, under the ~4%/yr hurdle. Target check **NO**: +35% → 1,370 = 23.1x EPS / 15.8x EV/EBITDA / **1.55x book on a 6.7% ROE** (warranted P/B at IDR COE 11–13%, g 4% ≈ 0.39x). Momentum negative (mom12 −22.7%, mom1 −5.1%); ADV IDR 16.3bn below the IDR 50bn floor → DISCARD. **Re-open:** a funded expansion restart **plus** a dividend/AFFO line clearing FR + spread at a lower entry.
